title: COUNTERING MALICIOUS CONTENT MODERATION EVASION IN ONLINE SOCIAL NETWORKS: SIMULATION AND DETECTION OF WORD CAMOUFLAGE
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical development of a multilingual tool (pyleetspeak) and a Transformer-based model to detect camouflaged text used to evade social media moderation. It does not evaluate or benchmark religious beliefs, morals, or ethical frameworks.
